status_definitions.AVAILABLE: Executable or importable and passed the stated probe; feature support may still be limited.

next_stage_status_definitions.CONTAINER_SETUP: A verified local container runtime makes a pinned container setup practical.
next_stage_status_definitions.REQUIRES_ARTIFACT_WORK: A canonical artifact exists, but it must be fetched, pinned, inspected, and adapted before execution.
next_stage_status_definitions.BLOCKED: No currently usable runtime or approved setup mechanism exists.
